inference: The exact source import chains identify the simulation asset linked from each fixed projectile feature asset. This establishes the serialized route and does not prove runtime activation.

The five common Boolean fields can be compared as serialized values because all three selected simulation assets use the same local class key and the same nested descriptor field identities. Their semantic roles remain unresolved.
No source-backed activation-distance or active-lifetime comparison is established by these captures.
unresolved: The shared DiceEx_Razer_GrenadeProximityTriggers import target has no Head 4892087 raw capture in coverage-decoder-v5.sqlite, so its typed trigger fields and any activation distance could not be extracted or raw-verified.

Selected simulation assets contain only the five common bool fields reported above (and one M4SLAM-specific local bool occurrence pair); no f32 operand was identified in those three assets. The hashed field names do not establish trigger, deployability, activation-distance or lifetime roles.

The root projectile decodes include many additional component fields, but no named field-to-consumer mapping establishes which value is an activation distance, deployability switch or active lifetime.
Serialized import chains and matching bytes do not prove native runtime activation, composition or behavior.
siteImpact: The Analyzer has no gadget table. These three selected source chains do not name a trigger radius, activation distance or lifetime, so no mine comparison value is proposed.
